subject: Millcross
prompt: A sprawling, wall-less crossing town on both banks of a grey river, viewed from the road at cart height, late afternoon. One mill-wheel housing is the only structure above one storey; everything else is single-height grey plank, patched canvas and roped tarpaulin, laid out with no plan along the roads. A queue of loaded carts and led animals stretches from the foreground toward the ford, longer than the town is wide. Palette ash-grey, rope-brown, tallow-yellow, with chalked crossed-roads-over-an-empty-bowl marks on tarpaulins. In the middle distance, former refugee tents that have grown plank walls and real doorframes — the seams between canvas and timber clearly visible.
_note: Newly authored to the recovered block-in schema (ABP-flux-dev-and-anchor.md) for this subject — the ABPs only ever block-in'd Gildmark and Norhollow. Composition: river bank on bg, single-storey plank rows + the one taller mill-wheel housing on mg (asymmetric — right bank denser, matching 'longer than the town is wide'), cart queue occluding the foreground.
